items.title: Decision Context: Persistent Behavioral Learning for AI Agents
items.title_zh: 决策上下文：面向 AI 智能体的持久行为学习
items.summary: Forge Decision Context (forge_dc) captures behavioral signals from human corrections and self-assessed tool-call failures, compiles them into imperative rule directives, and injects them at the decision points where they apply. On the new DC-Bench, it reaches 95% compliance versus 55% with naive retrieval while injecting approximately 10 times fewer tokens per query.

items.title: FinEvolveKG: Controlled and Attributable Prompt Evolution for Financial Knowledge Graph Construction
items.title_zh: FinEvolveKG：面向金融知识图谱构建的可控且可归因的提示演化
items.summary: FinEvolveKG is a knowledge-graph construction harness that separates reusable general and persona-policy prompt blocks and confines a reflective optimizer to the persona block, keeping the approved general block byte-stable and every edit attributable. On ticker-disjoint SEC 10-K splits, the complete two-stage block-constrained workflow improves over a frozen prompt baseline by 19.4-30.9% and over an unconstrained full-prompt workflow by 2.2-6.4%.

items.title: GPT‑6 Cyber: Advancing the frontier of aligned cybersecurity agents
items.title_zh: GPT-6 Cyber：推进对齐的网络安全智能体前沿
items.summary: OpenAI introduces GPT-6 Cyber, a cybersecurity model for finding exploitable vulnerabilities and developing fixes, trained to stay within authorized scope.

items.title: China Merchants' LionRock AI Lab Open-Sources Lion-ER-35B-A3B Embodied Reasoning Model
items.title_zh: 招商局 LionRock AI Lab 开源 Lion-ER-35B-A3B 具身推理模型
items.summary: China Merchants' LionRock AI Lab has open-sourced Lion-ER-35B-A3B, a 3B-active-parameter embodied reasoning model built with a capability-driven data engine. The lab reports that it beat its base model on ten benchmarks.

items.title: XStack: A Benchmark for ML Repo Migration
items.title_zh: XStack：面向机器学习代码仓库迁移的基准
items.summary: XStack is a benchmark that evaluates agents on migrating ML repositories from PyTorch on NVIDIA GPUs to JAX on Google TPUs, grading results against the source repository's published outcome. Claude Opus 5 passes 75%, GPT-5.6-sol 45%, and every other agent at most 40%.

items.title: Memory-Aware Multi-Agent Architecture with LLM-based Orchestration for Conversational Recommendation
items.title_zh: 面向对话推荐的内存感知多智能体架构与基于 LLM 的编排
items.summary: The paper proposes a memory-aware multi-agent architecture for conversational recommendation in which LLMs orchestrate intent refinement, query construction and interaction flow, with long-term memory as a first-class component. On the Amazon Reviews dataset, memory-enabled interactions recover up to 63% of the gap toward explicit-query scenarios and supervisory orchestration raises user acceptance by 28.9 percentage points.

items.title: Unpacking the Compute Efficiency of Strong-to-Weak OPD against GRPO
items.title_zh: 解析强模型到弱模型的 OPD 相对 GRPO 的计算效率
items.summary: The paper compares on-policy distillation (OPD) with GRPO by measuring held-out accuracy against training FLOPs across task difficulty, model size and domain. It finds that OPD generally loses to GRPO in accuracy per training FLOP with an external post-trained teacher, but when the teacher is the student's own GRPO checkpoint, OPD recovers that checkpoint's math accuracy with 50 times fewer distillation FLOPs, and multi-teacher OPD reaches joint GRPO performance on a two-domain mix with 42.0% fewer total FLOPs.

items.title: User Embeddings are Superpositions of Interpretable Behavioral Modes
items.title_zh: 用户嵌入是可解释行为模式的叠加
items.summary: The paper argues that user embeddings can be understood as sparse superpositions of interpretable behavioral modes, recoverable with sparse dictionary methods such as sparse autoencoders and nameable in natural language. It validates mode recovery on synthetic ground truth and applies the post-hoc, model-agnostic framework to classical and transformer-based embeddings from two real-world datasets, enabling zero-shot audience retrieval.

items.title: AtariBench: Evaluating Spatiotemporal Reasoning of Vision-Language Models in Atari Gameplay
items.title_zh: AtariBench：评估视觉语言模型在 Atari 游戏中的时空推理
items.summary: AtariBench evaluates vision-language models across 20 Atari 2600 games that require sequential decisions from high-temporal-resolution gameplay, decoupling in-game dynamics from wall-clock inference speed. The authors report that state-of-the-art VLMs often fail to infer object motion and direction, make brittle decisions and over-rely on textual interaction history, and use the benchmark to study memory design and prompting strategies.

items.title: Turkish Multimodal Video Fact-Checking: A New Dataset and a Comparison of Zero-Shot Agentic and Fine-Tuned Systems
items.title_zh: 土耳其多模态视频事实核查：新数据集与零样本智能体及微调系统对比
items.summary: TeViD is presented as the first multimodal video fact-checking dataset for Turkish, compiled from Teyit.org articles and enriched with translated Snopes articles and synthetic examples. The authors compare an agentic 3MFact-TR pipeline using Qwen2.5-7B and Qwen2-VL-7B with a LoRA fine-tuned Qwen2.5-7B baseline and report accuracy, macro F1 and ablation results.

items.title: Formally verifying agent-written full-stack web apps with PDD Kit
items.title_zh: 用 PDD Kit 形式化验证智能体编写的全栈 Web 应用
items.summary: PDD Kit turns developer intent into a Verus specification and tests agent-written full-stack web apps against it, targeting code generated at a scale that is hard for humans to review line by line.

items.title_zh: 如何在数据所在的任何位置灵活部署 LlamaParse
items.summary: LlamaIndex publishes guidance on deploying LlamaParse flexibly in the environments where a team's data lives.

items.title: AI for scientific discovery: How researchers use Claude
items.title_zh: AI 助力科学发现：研究人员如何使用 Claude
items.summary: Anthropic analyzed 207,000 research sessions to study how Claude is used in science, why some tasks get more use than others, and how AI could speed up discovery.
